The असर्वनामस्थान case-endings after अष्टन् 'eight', have acute accent, when it gets the form अष्टा।

Terms: accent-विभक्ति

A long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member, when the compound is a Name.

Terms: संहिता Lengthening
After the अङ्ग (stem) अष्टा (the form assumed by अष्टन् -- अष्टन आ विभक्तौ

), औश् is substituted for the endings of the Nominative 1st-Case and Accusative -2nd case.

Terms: Some substitution

आ is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a case-ending.

Terms: Some substitution
